name: Bulin 47 AI
tagline: Turn one portrait into a ten-second freestyle video with a fixed performance template
description: Bulin 47 AI is an independent fan-made photo-to-video tool. Users upload a portrait of themselves or a consenting adult to create a ten-second version of a fixed freestyle performance with its soundtrack. No prompt or reference-video upload is needed. Generated MP4 videos and unused generations are accessible through an account. The service is not affiliated with Bulin 47, and generation can change facial details, clothing and surrounding objects.
pricing: One-time purchases: $9.90 for one generation or $19.90 for three. Each video uses one generation. No subscription or free video generation.
pros: Prepared performance template requires no prompt or video upload
Downloadable MP4 videos with audio
Unused purchased generations remain available in the account
cons: Fixed performance template limits creative control
Exact likeness and unchanged backgrounds are not guaranteed
Requires a photo of yourself or a consenting adult; public figures and children are excluded

name: CreatorVault AI
tagline: AI prompts, workbooks and workflow resources for creators and business teams
description: CreatorVault AI offers digital resource packages for creator strategy, B2B lead generation and customer support workflows. Creator Blueprint Pro includes workbooks, planning resources and AI prompts for audience discovery, content strategy and creator business planning. Separate packages cover prospect research, outreach sequences and support-ticket processes. Products are sold through Gumroad as resources and implementation guidance; users build and configure their own workflows rather than receiving a hosted automation application.
pricing: One-time digital purchases on Gumroad: Creator Blueprint Pro starts at $29; B2B lead generation and customer support packages start at $49 each.
pros: Combines AI prompts with structured planning and workflow resources
Separate packages for creator, sales and support use cases
One-time purchases rather than recurring product subscriptions
cons: Resource packages require user implementation
Not a hosted CRM, ticketing system or autonomous agent
External AI or automation tools may be needed to implement workflows

name: AI Pigeon Meme
tagline: Turn a short line into a vertical video starring a whispering blue pigeon
description: AI Pigeon Meme creates eight-second vertical videos featuring a blue pigeon. Users write a short English line, choose an expression, action and whisper direction, and optionally add burned-in captions. The browser-based tool generates 720p clips for download and sharing in group chats or social posts. Google sign-in and paid credits are required; finished videos remain private in the account for 90 days.
pricing: Paid only: packs start at $4.90 for 20 credits; each video uses 10 credits. Monthly plans start at $9.90 for 60 credits. No free trial or signup credits.
pros: Simple controls for dialogue, expression and movement
Optional burned-in captions for vertical clips
One-time credit packs and monthly plans available
cons: Limited to one character style and eight-second clips
Exact voice and motion are not guaranteed
No free generation; stored videos expire after 90 days

name: Hotel Lobby AI
tagline: Create an orange-studio duet video from two portrait photos
description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two portrait photos into a template-based duet performance in an orange studio. Users set performer positions, add optional movement instructions, and choose portrait or landscape output at 480p, 720p or 1080p. The default template is approximately 15 seconds long and includes its soundtrack. Results can be reviewed and downloaded as MP4 files. Users must have permission to use both portraits, and exact facial identity or gestures are not guaranteed.
pricing: Paid prepaid credit packs; no subscription or free video generation. The default template costs 60 credits at 480p, 135 at 720p or 240 at 1080p. Check pack prices before purchase.
pros: Combines two portraits in one duet scene
Portrait and landscape formats with three quality options
Downloadable MP4 results and optional gesture directions
cons: Template-based performance limits scene control
No free video generation
Faces, gestures and soundtrack permissions require review before sharing

name: Distribb
tagline: Research keywords, publish SEO content and track AI search visibility
description: Distribb combines keyword research, AI article creation and scheduled CMS publishing with backlink exchange and AI search visibility tracking. Businesses can review content before publishing or enable automatic publishing through integrations such as WordPress, Webflow and Shopify. An AI agent handles research and content tasks, while higher-tier plans add managed video and social distribution. Its dashboards track search performance and AI citations; results depend on the content, site and market.
pricing: Paid subscription with a seven-day free trial. Pro costs $97/month, or $79/month billed yearly at $948. Higher-tier managed distribution is available.
pros: Connects keyword research with article creation and CMS publishing
Supports approval before publication
Tracks AI citations alongside search performance
cons: Requires a subscription after the trial
Managed distribution is limited to higher-tier plans
Generated content and backlink placements need editorial review

name: MarketOwl
tagline: AI marketer that creates strategies and executes multi-channel marketing campaigns.
description: MarketOwl serves as an AI marketer designed for founders and marketing professionals. It analyzes business funnels to develop tailored ICP strategies and automates campaign execution across channels such as Reddit, X, LinkedIn, SEO, email, and paid advertising. Users can run prebuilt playbooks, connect thousands of external tools via API, monitor sprints, and retain approval control over all generated content and outreach initiatives.
pricing: Free trial with $50 in starting credits; credit top-ups and subscription options available after trial.

name: BPM Finder
tagline: Analyze tempo and structure from reference audio to create original music briefs
description: BPM Finder analyzes uploaded audio directly in the browser to calculate tempo, musical key, meter, energy, waveform, and beat positions. It integrates audio recognition and an AI music agent that translates analyzed technical musical signals into structured, editable briefs for original music generation.
pricing: Free plan includes 20 starter credits; paid plans start at $10/month (billed annually) or $12/month for 3,600 credits.

Translates reference audio analysis into editable music generation briefs

name: PawCinema
tagline: Turn pet photos into stylized AI portraits across dozens of art styles.
description: PawCinema generates custom digital pet portraits from single cat or dog photos. Users can choose from 36 distinct art directions, such as watercolor, oil painting, cel animation, embroidery, and pop art. First-time users can create one portrait for free with web preview access, while full-resolution downloads and additional generations are available through pay-as-you-go credit top-ups without a subscription.
pricing: 1 portrait free; credit top-ups start at US$5 (approx. 100 credits / $1.00 per generation).

name: Pikkai
tagline: Discover AI products through a searchable directory and submit your own launch
description: Pikkai is an independent product directory with category browsing, search, and recent launches. Makers can submit a product for review through a free route that requires a public Pikkai badge or a paid expedited route. Paid submission covers review eligibility and does not guarantee acceptance, placement, traffic, or a publication date.
pricing: Free browsing; free maker submission requires a verified badge. Expedited submission: $5 one time.

Recent launch listings
Free and paid maker submission routes

name: RemoveMate
tagline: Remove photo backgrounds and clean up images with AI tools
description: RemoveMate is a browser-based image toolkit for removing backgrounds from product photos, portraits, pets, and everyday objects. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image, inspect the resulting cutout, and download it. Additional tools remove text and watermarks or reduce image blur. Fine edges and important details should be checked before using an edited image.
pricing: 10 free credits every 24 hours without signup; one-time packs: $9 for 100 credits or $19 for 250. Purchased credits do not expire.

Free daily credits without signup
One-time credit packs without a subscription

name: VeriMails
tagline: Find professional email addresses and verify contact lists through CSV or API
description: VeriMails provides email verification with SMTP checks, catch-all detection, bulk CSV processing, and a REST API. Its Email Finder searches for a professional address using a name and company domain. Teams can download verification results and receive webhook notifications when bulk jobs finish. Verification results flag uncertain or catch-all addresses for review rather than guaranteeing delivery.
pricing: 100 free signup credits; prepaid packs from $19 for 10,000 checks. Starter: $15/month or $150/year. Email Finder uses 20 credits per verified result.

REST API and bulk completion webhooks

Users can select aspect ratios, upload up to ten reference images to guide compositions, and modify photos using natural language prompts without mandatory account creation.

tagline: Product opportunity research platform tracking public payment signals, tipping trends, and site intelligence for builders.
description: Build or Skip is a product opportunity research tool designed for independent developers and startup teams. It monitors public payment signals, Buy Me a Coffee tipping data, domain metrics, and backlink resources to help creators evaluate commercial momentum, discover growing software categories, and validate product ideas before building.
pricing: Free preview available. Pro Monthly is $19/month, and Pro Yearly is $15.83/month ($190 billed annually).

name: Refinely Human
tagline: AI text humanizer designed to adapt AI-generated content across field-specific audience profiles.
description: Refinely Human transforms AI-generated text into humanized writing across 25 field-specific audience profiles, ranging from standard to PhD academic tone levels. It includes writing modes, AI detection checking, paraphrasing, and readability analysis tools.

pros: Local frame and text recognition
Automatic caption handling with restore controls

pricing: 10 successfully handled videos free in total; Pro $17.99/year or $29.99 lifetime. The free allowance does not reset monthly.
tagline: Automatically manage YouTube captions and reduce duplicate subtitles with local OCR
description: subtitle.im is a desktop Chrome extension that enables available YouTube captions and detects burned-in subtitles using local frame sampling and OCR. It can hide duplicate switchable captions or follow preferences for different languages, with controls to restore captions. Video frames and subtitle text used for detection are processed locally. It does not generate, translate, download, or alter burned-in subtitles. Pro adds ongoing handling and channel or video rules.
